title: TargetAttributionV2 — Plan-bound provider-attested occupancy sidecar for resolved target endpoints
description: CURRENT selected target-attribution schema for this successor. Historical TargetAttributionV1 (foundation/target-attribution.schema.v1.json) remains a retained document and is refused by this profile. Typed separate INPUT/return record. NOT a native fact payload field and MUST NOT be added to relation-payload-schemas.v2.json $defs. Bound to PlanId + source fact2 + the producing provider closure. Identity is raw SHA-256 of C(this record). Provider attestation after host join validation. Host MAY derive an ephemeral first-party projection only on exact inventory native-id equality of targetNativeId. Host MUST NOT parse SubjectIdV1 namespace:opaque spelling to invent kind, occupancy, or evaluationNativeId. logicalPath is a non-authoritative external/unknown hint, never occupancy identity. packageManifestPath remains the sole package coordinate (no evaluationPackageManifestPath). Frozen24 historical Runs remain replayable only under frozen24's own selected V1 schema/profile.

planId.description: The Plan whose evaluation consumes this input. Closure requires the named fact2 to belong to this Plan's views. planId is a locator, not hashed as a parent into EnumerationPlanV1.

sourceFactId.description: The native fact whose target endpoint this record attributes. Unique with planId: at most one TargetAttributionV2 per (planId, sourceFactId).

producerClosure.description: Must equal the source fact's producerClosure. The named closure must be Plan-selected kind=provider. This is the typed provider return/capture authority, not a second fact mint and not a host guess.

targetUniverse.description: Bare 64-hex suffix of the TARGET endpoint universe. Must equal sourceFact.targetUniverse. Never silently swapped with sourceUniverse.

targetNativeId.description: Exact opaque native target identity copied from the fact payload's resolved target-id field (resolvedTarget / resolvedBinding / resolvedCallee / to / reachable). Payload join only. NOT the occupancy-compare field for kinds whose inventory grammar is not SubjectIdV1.

kind.description: Stored kinds are file|symbol|package. unknown is explicit metadata, not a fourth subject kind and not export.

occupancy.description: first-party: evaluation occupancy identity is a first-party inventory subject of targetUniverse. external: attributed outside first-party inventory. unknown: producer/host could not decide. unknown occupancy is NOT occupancy=external and is NOT a false match.

exported.description: Tri-state for kind=symbol only. MUST be null when kind is file, package, or unknown.

logicalPath.description: Non-authoritative hint ONLY when occupancy is external or unknown AND kind is file or symbol. MUST be null when occupancy=first-party. MUST be null when kind=package (package location is packageManifestPath). NEVER occupancy identity. NEVER used to invent packageManifestPath or evaluationNativeId.

packageManifestPath.description: Sole package coordinate. REQUIRED non-null when kind=package and occupancy=first-party (inventory join of packageName=evaluationNativeId, path=packageManifestPath). REQUIRED non-null when kind=package and occupancy=external (query endpoint coordinate; NOT a first-party inventory join). MUST be null when kind is not package. MUST be null when occupancy=unknown.

evaluationNativeId.description: Typed evaluation-subject nativeSubjectId for occupancy. REQUIRED non-null iff occupancy=first-party. MUST be null when occupancy is external or unknown. File: LogicalPath matching inventory nativeSubjectId. Package: attested packageName matching inventory nativeSubjectId. Symbol: SubjectIdV1 MUST byte-equal targetNativeId. Host MUST NOT derive this by parsing targetNativeId.

SubjectIdV1.description: Opaque native payload identity. Host MUST NOT parse the namespace to invent occupancy.

proofInputRef.standing: selected domain target-attribution; identity-schemas.v3 byDomain document pointer names this schema

x-opensip-join-law.standing: CURRENT successor occupancy law. Frozen24 V1 compare (payload native id vs evaluation N first) is historical and is not selected when a sidecar is missing. Host validates joins. A retained TargetAttributionV2 is PROVIDER ATTESTATION captured as a host-derived typed input. Host derivation is an EPHEMERAL projection on exact inventory native-id equality of targetNativeId only and MUST NOT be written as this record. Unknown attestation MUST NOT override independently known inventory metadata.
x-opensip-join-law.selectedProfile: This successor selects TargetAttributionV2. schemaVersion=1 sidecars refuse TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION. Missing sidecar does not restore V1 payload-inequality nomatch.
x-opensip-join-law.evaluationSubject: subject3 / evaluation-subject is (universe, kind, nativeSubjectId); PACKAGE ONLY adds required packageManifestPath from inventory row.path. File/symbol shape unchanged.
x-opensip-join-law.payloadPlane: targetNativeId is the opaque payload copy. Unchanged ImportsPayloadV1 SubjectIdV1 grammar.
x-opensip-join-law.occupancyPlane: MatchingFacts for endpoint=target compare E to occupancy identity, not to targetNativeId, except where those strings are already the same grammar (symbol exact-id).
x-opensip-join-law.producerReturn: CURRENT worker product is OccupancyCompanionV1 on negotiated FactBatchV3 (token target-attribution-v2), associated by candidateOrdinal before fact2 exists. Host bind_worker_occupancy mechanically projects THIS record after mint, filling planId/sourceFactId/producerClosure from retained Plan/execution-plan stage spec/selected view. COMPLETE58 ProviderTargetAttributionReturnV2 wrapper envelope after fact2 mint is historical and is not delivery. Host captures projected records into hostCapture.hostDerivedRefs domain=target-attribution. Missing token or empty companions is lawful occupancy-unknown except exact-id ephemeral. Host MUST NOT parse SubjectIdV1 to invent this record. origin is not an admit blessing.
x-opensip-join-law.producerClosureKind: producerClosure equals fact.producerClosure and closures[pc].kind=provider. TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_PRODUCER_NOT_PROVIDER otherwise.
joins: sourceFactId is a fact2 of that Plan, present in a selected view of producerClosure
producerClosure equals fact.producerClosure, is Plan-selected, and closures[producerClosure].kind=provider
targetNativeId equals the payload field named by evaluator-projection-registry.v1.json relations[fact.relation].targetNativeIdField at fact.resolution
x-opensip-join-law.inventoryIdentity: File/symbol identity is the triple (universe, kind, nativeSubjectId). Package identity is the quadruple (universe, kind=package, nativeSubjectId=packageName, packageManifestPath=row.path).

derivation.when: targetNativeIdField is present and the set of distinct inventory identities whose nativeSubjectId EXACTLY equals payload targetNativeId (file/symbol triple, or package quadruple) across admitted SubjectInventoryV1 rows of this Plan has size 1
derivation.action: host computes an ephemeral projection {occupancy:first-party, kind, exported or null, logicalPath:null, packageManifestPath:row.path or null, evaluationNativeId:row.nativeSubjectId}. It is not a TargetAttributionV2 and not a provider output. This is the existing exact-id authority (symbols; accidental C15 colon-path files whose inventory N already equals SubjectIdV1).
derivation.sizeZero: no exact-id first-party identity. Ephemeral occupancy is not first-party. Absent sidecar: occupancy unknown, not payload-inequality nomatch.
derivation.sizeGreaterThanOne: ambiguous exact-id identities. Ephemeral kind/occupancy unknown.
derivation.never: parse namespace:opaque SubjectIdV1 spelling; never invent evaluationNativeId or first-party packageManifestPath from logicalPath or by stripping a prefix

x-opensip-join-law.sidecarFirstPartyJoin: occupancy=first-party requires evaluationNativeId non-null and a unique inventory identity of sidecar.kind: file uses (U, file, evaluationNativeId); package uses (U, package, evaluationNativeId, packageManifestPath); symbol uses (U, symbol, evaluationNativeId) and evaluationNativeId MUST equal targetNativeId. Size!=1 refuses TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_FIRST_PARTY_NOT_IN_INVENTORY. Null evaluationNativeId or missing first-party packageManifestPath is ADMISSION REFUSAL, not accepted unknown.
x-opensip-join-law.precedence: Admit sidecar if present. Ephemeral exact-id projection is computed independently. Prefer independently known ephemeral fields over sidecar unknown. Sidecar occupancy=external while ephemeral occupancy=first-party refuses TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_EXTERNAL_CONTRADICTS_FIRST_PARTY. Sidecar first-party occupancy identity I_sc and independently known ephemeral first-party identity I_eph MUST agree; I_eph ≠ I_sc refuses TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_EPHEMERAL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT and MUST NOT overwrite ephemeral nativeId (C15: payload/inventory exact colon-path file vs sidecar naming a different same-kind file). Equal identities admit as sidecar+ephemeral. Missing sidecar uses ephemeral only.

conflictUniqueness.providerSelfContradiction: Within one Plan, two first-party V2 records that share (producerClosure, targetUniverse, targetNativeId) and disagree on occupancy identity (kind, evaluationNativeId, packageManifestPath or empty) refuse TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_PROVIDER_OCCUPANCY_CONFLICT. This is one provider contradicting itself about one opaque payload id in one universe. It is not a general alias and does not equate opaque strings across different producerClosures.
conflictUniqueness.not: Do not treat two unrelated providers' equal opaque strings as one identity. Do not invent (universe, targetNativeId) aliases.
conflictUniqueness.ephemeralIdentityConflict: Independently known exact-id first-party occupancy identity cannot be silently rewritten by a contradictory first-party sidecar. Refuse TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_EPHEMERAL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT. Occupancy identity is (kind, evaluationNativeId) for file/symbol and (kind, evaluationNativeId, packageManifestPath) for package.

packagePathCases.first-party-package: packageManifestPath required; inventory join; logicalPath null; evaluationNativeId=packageName
packagePathCases.external-package: packageManifestPath required as query endpoint coordinate so GraphEndpoint kind=package is representable; NOT a first-party inventory join; logicalPath null; evaluationNativeId null; query nativeSubjectId remains opaque targetNativeId
packagePathCases.unknown-package: packageManifestPath null; logicalPath null; evaluationNativeId null; fact unprojectable (cannot form a complete package endpoint tuple)

compare.endpointSource: unchanged: payload source field vs E.nativeSubjectId; package also matches manifestPath
compare.endpointTarget: 1 payload target field present at admitted rung; 2 fact.targetUniverse==E.universe else nomatch; 3 occupancy projection; 4 occupancy=external => nomatch for first-party E; 5 occupancy unknown or missing occupancy identity => unknown, NOT payload-inequality nomatch, unless kind is known and != E.kind (known kind nomatch); 6 occupancy=first-party MATCH iff E equals (U, kind, evaluationNativeId, packageManifestPath or empty)

x-opensip-join-law.absence: Missing sidecar and no exact-id ephemeral identity: occupancy unknown, not nomatch, not false. Malformed first-party sidecar is admission refusal. Known incompatible universe remains nomatch. Complete search plus only known nomatches and no unknowns may prove none; unmapped facts block none.
x-opensip-join-law.reconciliation: Prefer independently known ephemeral fields. Fill remaining unknown from sidecar. Result used for matching is the reconciled occupancy projection, never raw sidecar alone and never a host parse.
x-opensip-join-law.noBacklink: fact2 descriptors are unchanged. This record names sourceFactId; no fact field names an attribution digest.

x-opensip-new-internal-faults.standing: Internal diagnostic keys, not DomainDetailCode members and not D9 codes. Public standing is the EXISTING evaluator-fault typed boundary in evaluator-fault-observation.schema.v3.json x-opensip-routes. Provider-emitted schema failures: condition=input-schema-invalid origin=provider-return → operational-failed PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION faultCause=provider-protocol detail=EVALUATION.INPUT_REFUSED. Provider-emitted join/conflict failures: condition=input-join-invalid origin=provider-return → same public detail. Host-invented mapping: origin=host-internal → operational-failed SYSTEM.OUTCOME.ILLEGAL_STATE faultCause=host-invariant detail=HOST.INVARIANT_VIOLATED. Host retains the unmodified diagnostic bytes containing the internal key. No alias and no new D9 code. LIVE D9 successor-artifact remains a future host obligation and is not discharged.
